page.overview:
Who is Mustachible?

Nolan Grayson (father) Debbie Grayson (mother)

Mustachible was an evil variant of the main Invincible and a supporting antagonist in the third season of the series.

Mustachible was one of the variants of Invincible who would be assembled by Angstrom Levy to start the Invincible War in the mainstream universe.

His appearance is the same as the main Invincible, though he donnes a thin, angled mustache, commonly worn by Viltrumite males. Like others of his kind, Mustachible wore the traditional imperial attire. However, as a member of the highest echelons of Viltrumite society, his outfit featured a refined variation modelled off of his superhero suit, with his "I"-shaped chest logo and darker undertones.
